thought: This is a memorial monument shot requiring a solemn, majestic atmosphere. The prompt should emphasize the tower as the central subject with dramatic low-angle composition to convey reverence. Since the visual style requires realistic thick-painted 2D animation with strong contrast and desaturated earth tones, I'll specify lighting that creates dramatic chiaroscuro while maintaining the peaceful post-war atmosphere. The model struggles with complex layouts, so I'll keep the composition straightforward: centered monument with clear sky background.
prompt: Wide establishing shot, solemn memorial stone tower standing majestically on mountain summit. Exposure: ISO 100, f/11, 1/125s, natural daylight. Lighting: Golden hour sunset lighting with dramatic chiaroscuro, strong light-dark contrast, warm amber and orange tones mixing with cool blue shadows, directional side lighting emphasizing the tower's geometric form and carved details. Composition: Symmetrical centered composition, low-angle perspective looking upward at monument to emphasize majesty and reverence, tower occupying central third rising into sky, mountain peak base visible in foreground. Depth of Field: Deep, sharp focus throughout from foreground rocks to distant sky. Lens: 24mm wide-angle lens capturing full monument and environment. Subject: Tall geometric stone memorial tower, robust angular construction, Chinese characters carved prominently on tower face reading '狼牙山五壮士纪念塔', weathered stone texture, solid foundation on rocky mountain peak. Background: Dramatic sunset sky with warm orange and purple gradient transitioning to deep blue, wispy clouds, distant mountain silhouettes fading into atmospheric haze. Visual Style: Realistic thick-painted 2D animation aesthetic, strong painterly brushwork texture, desaturated earth tone color palette with muted ochres, umbers, slate grays, limited but deliberate color saturation, high contrast between illuminated and shadow areas, epic historical gravitas. Genre: Memorial monument photography, historical landscape. Mood: Solemn, reverent, peaceful, majestic, commemorative. Atmosphere: Quiet dignity of peacetime remembrance, eternal vigilance, heroic sacrifice honored.
